correctness.rationale: Self-contained index-strong-divisibility proof establishes gcd(a,b)=u, gcd(a,c)=d for 3|n and 1 otherwise, and db=a+uc. For n=4, unique canonical monomials mod b give a rectangular Apéry set, binomial toric ideal, symmetric Frobenius/Hilbert formulas. For 6|n, distinct normal forms mod c yield analogous results. For all remaining even n>=8 the only possible Herzog–Watanabe gluing fails because a/u>d but a/u must divide d-y, 1<=d-y<=d. Every quantifier and boundary is covered. Exact independently implemented Dijkstra Apéry tests passed 24 test cases (15 symmetric); finite tests do not replace the infinite argument.

value.rationale: Complete natural two-parameter classification of Gorenstein/symmetric behavior for norm-one Chebyshev–Lucas triple semigroups, with an isolated exceptional n=4 and a disjoint infinite n divisible by six branch. Distinct minimal two-binomial presentations, rectangular Apéry sets, Hilbert series and Frobenius formulas explain the structural arithmetic bifurcation; this is more than a numerical recomputation or arbitrary slice. The positive/negative recurrence sign shift changes the n=4 boundary rather than merely renaming a solved formula.
